Chapter 7073: Grand Momentum

Chapter 7073: Grand Momentum

“Death.” Heavenly Whale raised his staff again.

Those in the ocean watched attentively, tempted by the promise of true rebirth. Could Octopus be telling the truth?

The celestial ones knew about Octopus better than anyone. At the very least, they considered Octopus to be equal to the high heaven.

For Demise and Slayer, they were relatively close to Octopus. Thus, they should be prime candidates for revival. It didn’t take long before they made up their mind.

“It appears you shall have to die today.” Zhao Dachui uttered coldly.

“You all couldn’t defeat the enforcer, let alone kill me.” Li Qiye said.

When listeners heard this, they became frozen.

“Does he mean...” One of them murmured after getting the impression that Li Qiye loomed above the high heaven.

“That’s impossible.” An immortal said. If someone were superior to the high heaven, they would have taken the spot. However, Li Qiye didn’t sound like he was lying.

The celestial immortals had a serious expression. They didn’t know whether he was telling the truth, but he certainly believed in his words.

“Initiate the grand momentum!” Heavenly Whale pinned his staff against the platform, causing it to release primordial rays. This resembled the start of time when the high heaven was born.

“Initiate.” The others finally obeyed and formed mantras, causing beams to erupt. They raised their hands and the ocean became radiant.

With the ocean awakened, Heaven Pit revealed its true form.

“Is this Mortal World?” A few immortals found the opening world familiar.

“It is Mortal World...” A golden immortal murmured.

Those who came from Mortal World became overwhelmed with emotions.

It looked the same before the destruction with majestic mountain ranges and rivers. In between were countless cities and inhabitants. Cultivators prospered under such favorable circumstances...

It had contained incredible powers, birthing overlords and immortals. Unfortunately, Heaven Pit heralded its demise.

Now, more Mortal Worlds appeared, each in a different spot on the river of time. They stacked together in a surreal manner, exponentially increasing the overarching power.

“How did this happen?” An immortal murmured.

“When they created Heaven Pit back then, they infused the river of time into it as well. These stacks happened long ago.” Someone explained.

“Does that mean they have refined everything even before the start of the battle?” Another asked.

“Yes.” A primordial immortal agreed.

“Eternal life, curse the high heaven!” The group chanted and the river of time flowed around Li Qiye.

He became the center of the universe, the creator of everything.

“Is this an attack?” Spectators became confused.

If anything, the grand momentum seemed to be nourishing Li Qiye. Stars appeared around him.

“Buzz.” Each of his breaths birthed a world. As more stars and galaxies emerged, they started affecting his vitality and life force. The universe continued to grow larger around Li Qiye.
